_comment: Declarative manifest of every artifact that MUST ship inside a Port Daddy release tarball. This is the single source of truth for `pd batten verify` (the fail-loud staging gate) and `pd batten imprint` (the content-addressed seal). Populated from the ACTUAL staging steps in .github/workflows/release.yml (job build-binaries). It replaces the scattered per-binary checks that once drifted around pd-bosun and Squid; pd-bosun itself is deliberately absent from v3.28+ single-supervisor archives. Every current runtime artifact is declared here once and validated together. `buildCmd` is informational (batten VALIDATES staging, it does not build). Paths are relative to the staged dir passed to `pd batten verify --staged-dir <dir>` (dist/ in CI).

artifacts.buildCmd: node scripts/build-single-binary.mjs --outfile=dist/pd (companion binary the pd launcher execs)
node scripts/build-single-binary.mjs --outfile=dist/pd (writes port-daddy-manifest.json next to the binary)

artifacts._comment: Single-supervisor (3.28) layout: tentacles ship ONLY under bin/. The flat top-level copies and pd-bosun were retired with the tap cutover (2026-08-05) — the formula's tarball gate rejects >=3.28.0 tarballs carrying either. lib/squid/assets.ts resolves execDir/bin and execDir/../share/port-daddy/bin.
artifacts.buildCmd: cp bin/pd-hook-prompt dist/bin/pd-hook-prompt (POSIX shell tentacle; no build)
cp bin/pd-hook-precompact dist/bin/pd-hook-precompact (Claude-only compaction checkpoint; no build)
cp bin/pd-hook-pre-tool dist/bin/pd-hook-pre-tool (POSIX shell tentacle; no build)
cp bin/pd-hook-post-tool dist/bin/pd-hook-post-tool (POSIX shell tentacle; no build)
cp bin/pd-hook-stop dist/bin/pd-hook-stop (POSIX shell tentacle; no build)
cp bin/pd-statusline dist/bin/pd-statusline (staged under bin/ per lib/squid/adapter.ts tentaclePath fallback)
cp hooks/sessionstart-pilot.mjs dist/hooks/sessionstart-pilot.mjs (dependency-free Pilot steering hook)

artifacts._comment: The canonical Port Daddy agent skill the formula pkgshare-installs and `pd setup` symlinks into every runtime's skill registry. The pre-binary npm formula shipped it from the source tarball; the binary tarball must carry it explicitly or every brew install loses `pd setup`'s skill links.

artifacts.buildCmd: cp -R skills/port-daddy-agent-skill dist/skills/port-daddy-agent-skill (SKILL.md is the file the formula's test block asserts)

artifacts._comment: Port Daddy Pilot source rendered by `pd setup` into each runtime's native agent format (lib/pilot-agent-render.ts).

artifacts.buildCmd: cp -R agents/port-daddy-pilot dist/agents/port-daddy-pilot (AGENT.md + agent.config.json are the files the formula's test block asserts)

artifacts._comment: onnxruntime-node runtime libs staged by the shared packaging primitive used by both compiled builders. Filenames are platform-specific, so this asserts the directory exists and is non-empty. Semantic and hybrid search are product capabilities, not optional performance enhancements; supported release targets fail closed when this cargo is absent.
